post.title: Netflix made $45.2B in 2025. Ads were only about 3%
post.ig:
Netflix made $45.2B in 2025. Ads? About 3%.
Nearly all of it is monthly fees from 325M+ paid memberships.
After losing 200,000 subscribers in Q1 2022, Netflix added a cheaper ad plan: $8.99 vs $19.99 for Standard in the US (March 2026 prices).
Ad revenue topped $1.5B in 2025; Netflix expects roughly $3B in 2026, and over 60% of new sign-ups pick the ads plan.
Sources: Netflix FY2025 Form 10-K, Q4 2025 and Q2 2026 shareholder letters, CNBC, Variety.
